This tutorial covers estimation for the two most common identification
strategies: a-fixable (backdoor) and p-fixable (front-door / NPS).
It uses simulated examples where the true effect is known.

## Setup

```{julia}
import Pkg
Pkg.activate(joinpath(@__DIR__, ".."); io=devnull)
using CausalGraphs, DataFrames, Random, Statistics, Printf

logistic(x) = inv(1 + exp(-x))
```

---

## 1. Backdoor Adjustment (a-fixable)

### Graph

```
X → A → Y
X → Y
```

```{julia}
g_bd = make_graph(
    vertices = [:X, :A, :Y],
    di_edges  = [(:X, :A), (:X, :Y), (:A, :Y)],
)
println("strategy: ", identify(g_bd, :A, :Y).strategy)
```

### Data — true ACE = 2.0

```{julia}
function sim_backdoor(n; seed=1)
    Random.seed!(seed)
    X = randn(n)
    A = Float64.(rand(n) .< logistic.(0.2 .+ 0.8 .* X))
    Y = 1 .+ 2 .* A .+ X .+ randn(n)
    DataFrame(X=X, A=A, Y=Y)
end

df_bd = sim_backdoor(1_000)
first(df_bd, 3)
```

### Estimation

```{julia}
res_bd = estimate_causal(a=[1,0], data=df_bd, graph=g_bd,
                          treatment=:A, outcome=:Y)

println("True ACE = 2.0")
@printf("TMLE:    ACE = %.3f  95%% CI (%.3f, %.3f)\n",
        res_bd[:TMLE].ACE, res_bd[:TMLE].lower_ci, res_bd[:TMLE].upper_ci)
@printf("Onestep: ACE = %.3f\n", res_bd[:Onestep].ACE)
@printf("Gcomp:   ACE = %.3f\n", res_bd[:Gcomp].ACE)
@printf("IPW:     ACE = %.3f\n", res_bd[:IPW].ACE)
```

### With SuperLearner

```{julia}
#| eval: false
res_sl = estimate_causal(
    a=[1,0], data=df_bd, graph=g_bd, treatment=:A, outcome=:Y,
    superlearner_Y=true, superlearner_A=true, crossfit=true, K=5,
)
```

### Scalar a — E[Y(1)] and E[Y(0)] separately

```{julia}
res1 = estimate_causal(a=1, data=df_bd, graph=g_bd, treatment=:A, outcome=:Y)
res0 = estimate_causal(a=0, data=df_bd, graph=g_bd, treatment=:A, outcome=:Y)

@printf("E[Y(1)] = %.3f\n", res1[:TMLE].EYa)
@printf("E[Y(0)] = %.3f\n", res0[:TMLE].EYa)
@printf("ACE     = %.3f\n", res1[:TMLE].EYa - res0[:TMLE].EYa)
```

---

## 2. Front-Door / NPS Adjustment (p-fixable)

### Graph

```
A → M → Y
A ↔ Y   (hidden U confounds A and Y)
X → A, X → Y, X → M
```

```{julia}
g_fd = make_graph(
    vertices = [:X, :A, :M, :Y],
    bi_edges  = [(:A, :Y)],
    di_edges  = [(:X, :A), (:X, :Y), (:X, :M), (:A, :M), (:M, :Y)],
)
println("strategy: ", identify(g_fd, :A, :Y).strategy)
```

### Data — true mediated ACE ≈ 1.8 (= 1.2 × 1.5)

```{julia}
function sim_frontdoor(n; seed=2)
    Random.seed!(seed)
    X = randn(n); U = randn(n)
    A = Float64.(rand(n) .< logistic.(-0.2 .+ 0.6 .* X .+ 0.5 .* U))
    M = 0.4 .+ 1.2 .* A .+ 0.7 .* X .+ randn(n)
    Y = 1.0 .+ 1.5 .* M .+ X .+ U .+ randn(n)
    DataFrame(X=X, A=A, M=M, Y=Y)
end

df_fd = sim_frontdoor(800)
first(df_fd, 3)
```

### Estimation

```{julia}
res_fd = estimate_causal(a=[1,0], data=df_fd, graph=g_fd,
                          treatment=:A, outcome=:Y)

println("True ACE ≈ 1.8  (= 1.2 × 1.5)")
@printf("TMLE:    ACE = %.3f  95%% CI (%.3f, %.3f)\n",
        res_fd[:TMLE].ACE, res_fd[:TMLE].lower_ci, res_fd[:TMLE].upper_ci)
@printf("Onestep: ACE = %.3f\n", res_fd[:Onestep].ACE)
```

### Pure front-door (no observed confounders)

```{julia}
g_fd_pure = make_graph(
    vertices = [:A, :M, :Y],
    bi_edges  = [(:A, :Y)],
    di_edges  = [(:A, :M), (:M, :Y)],
)

function sim_fd_pure(n; seed=3)
    Random.seed!(seed)
    U = randn(n)
    A = Float64.(rand(n) .< logistic.(U))
    M = 0.5 .* A .+ randn(n)      # coefficient 0.5
    Y = 0.3 .* M .+ 0.4 .* U .+ randn(n)  # true ACE = 0.5 × 0.3 = 0.15
    DataFrame(A=A, M=M, Y=Y)
end

df_fd_pure = sim_fd_pure(1_200)
res_fd_pure = estimate_causal(a=[1,0], data=df_fd_pure, graph=g_fd_pure,
                               treatment=:A, outcome=:Y)
println("True ACE = 0.15")
@printf("TMLE:    %.3f\n", res_fd_pure[:TMLE].ACE)
@printf("Onestep: %.3f\n", res_fd_pure[:Onestep].ACE)
```

## 3. Simulation comparison: TMLE vs Onestep vs IPW

```{julia}
function sim_compare(n_reps=200, n=500)
    tmle = Float64[]; aipw = Float64[]; ipw = Float64[]
    for seed in 1:n_reps
        df  = sim_backdoor(n; seed)
        res = estimate_causal(a=[1,0], data=df, graph=g_bd,
                              treatment=:A, outcome=:Y)
        push!(tmle, res[:TMLE].ACE)
        push!(aipw, res[:Onestep].ACE)
        push!(ipw,  res[:IPW].ACE)
    end
    println("n=$n, reps=$n_reps, true ACE=2.0")
    println("          Bias      RMSE")
    for (name, v) in [("TMLE", tmle), ("Onestep", aipw), ("IPW", ipw)]
        bias = mean(v) - 2.0
        rmse = sqrt(mean((v .- 2.0).^2))
        @printf("  %-8s %+.4f   %.4f\n", name, bias, rmse)
    end
end

sim_compare()
```
